description: Cinematic anime trailer, MUSIC ONLY (no voice): a cute little parasite on a journey through Delhi, India. 60s trailer score (LTX t2v at 64x64, audio extracted, video throwaway) + 12 anime 9:16 clips (8s down to 5s, 84s of footage) cut to 60s -> final: trailer score at 100%, clip ambient audio ducked to 20%.
narrationPrompt: Epic cinematic anime trailer score, 60 seconds, NO voice, NO narration, NO speech, purely instrumental. A cute-but-epic adventure theme for a tiny little creature exploring a huge city: starts with a single playful plucked string and a soft curious motif over warm desert air, then builds with clapping tabla and dhol drums, bhangra-style percussion, bright sitar and flute melodies, a swelling orchestral string section, brass stabs, shimmering strings, and a big triumphant orchestral finale with full percussion. The mood is warm, funny, curious and heartwarming — like a beloved animated feature's main title theme. Clean professional trailer mix, rich low end, crisp highs, dramatic swells, no talking, no words, no vocals, no crowd chants.
